name: XDAILY
expansion: eXplained Daily – science for curious minds
tagline: Science and how things work, explained clearly: space, planet Earth, everyday technology, the human body, physics, chemistry and the big ideas
description: XDAILY explains science and the way things work for curious adults: why the sky is blue, how GPS knows where you are, what happens inside a star, how the heart pumps, why ice floats and how scientists know what they know, in plain words and without hype.
author: XDAILY Science Desk

categories.name: Space
categories.description: The Sun, the Moon, planets, stars, galaxies and the tools we use to study them, from seasons and eclipses to black holes and the edge of the observable universe.

categories.name: Planet Earth
categories.description: Weather and climate, oceans and tides, volcanoes and earthquakes, rivers, rocks and the cycles that keep our planet working.

categories.name: How Things Work
categories.description: The science inside everyday technology: GPS, microwaves, batteries, the internet, touchscreens, refrigerators, aircraft and more.

categories.name: The Human Body
categories.description: How the body works, from heartbeat and breathing to sleep, senses, immunity and digestion. Explanations only, never medical advice.

categories.name: Physics & Chemistry
categories.description: Light, sound, heat, electricity, atoms and reactions: the rules of matter and energy explained with everyday examples.

categories.name: Big Ideas
categories.description: Evolution, relativity, quantum theory, the scientific method and the discoveries that changed how we see the world, and how we know they are true.
